name: ugt
description: UGT org-standard marketplace for teams building web apps on Next.js + Prisma/SQL Server + Keycloak + Jenkins + SonarQube

plugins.name: ugt-core
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic foundation: ugt-handoff work-state skill, ugt-context knowledge-base bootstrap (docs/project-context/), audit-trail hooks, and the normative org contracts (database, cicd, auth, design, harness). Installed automatically as a dependency of stack platforms.

plugins.name: ugt-nextjs-platform
plugins.description: Org standards for Next.js projects: SQL Server via Prisma, SSO/LDAP/Local login + RBAC, test/lint tooling, Jenkins + SonarQube + Docker deploy, plus the harness layer (CLAUDE.md, rules, state, audit log)

plugins.name: ugt-nextjs-standard
plugins.description: The recommended bundle — one install brings ugt-nextjs-platform + superpowers (the development pipeline) + skill-creator (build project skills to the same standard)

plugins.name: ugt-python-platform
plugins.description: Org standards for Python projects (deploy-only for now): Jenkins + SonarQube + OWASP + Docker deploy for FastAPI / Flask / Django / batch jobs, with minimal lint/test tooling so the org Quality Gate passes
